desc: Implement solution using precomputed straight-run suffix/prefix DP per cell and direction with clockwise-turn combination
Define the four diagonal direction vectors and the clockwise 90-degree turn mapping (DR->DL->UL->UR->DR); verified against Examples 1 and 2
Handle edge cases: single-cell grid [[1]] -> 1, grids with no 1 -> 0, length-1 paths, and zero-turn straight segments
Run the 4 provided examples in code and confirm outputs (5, 4, 5, 1)
Write a brute-force simulator and differentially test vs the DP on many small random grids (n,m <= 6); 0 mismatches
Performance check on 500x500 grid; O(n*m) with small constants, no timeout
